name: Black Sperm

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK (+10) DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 12000% Attack shareable [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies in a row over 5 hits (only affected by advanced damage modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. This damage is not shared with targets that cannot take damage. Before actively casting the Ultimate, absorbs all Split Black Sperm on the battlefield. Each absorbed Split Black Sperm increases the Ultimate's DMG by an additional 20%, lasting until this unit's next active turn.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 15000% Attack shareable [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies in a row over 5 hits (only affected by advanced damage modifiers). Ignores 60% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. This damage is not shared with targets that cannot take damage. Before actively casting the Ultimate, absorbs all Split Black Sperm on the battlefield. Each absorbed Split Black Sperm increases the Ultimate's DMG by an additional 30%, lasting until this unit's next active turn. Permanently grants 20% [All DMG Bonus] to all allies and reduces [All DMG Reduction] of all enemies% (cannot be dispelled). Self and the ally with the highest ATK permanently gain [Black Sperm's Revenge]. [Black Sperm's Revenge]: When using an Ultimate, the character deals [Specialized Bonus DMG] equal to 800% of their Max HP to the enemy with the highest Max HP (can CRIT, PvP only).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Permanently gains 20% [Support Enhancement]. When about to be defeated in the first 9 rounds, enters the [Invincible] state, absorbing all incoming DMG. Before this unit's next action, restores 100% HP and continues fighting. Can trigger up to 4 times.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Permanently gains 30% [Support Enhancement]. When about to be defeated in the first 9 rounds, enters the [Invincible] state, absorbing all incoming DMG. Before this unit's next action, restores 100% HP and continues fighting. Can trigger up to 5 times.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Permanently gains 40% [Support Enhancement]. When about to be defeated in the first 9 rounds, enters the [Invincible] state, absorbing all incoming DMG. Before this unit's next action, restores 100% HP and continues fighting. Can trigger up to 6 times.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Upon entering battle, permanently reduces DMG taken by 30%. After each time this unit is attacked, 2 Split Black Sperm are created to assist in battle. Each Split Black Sperm inherits 100% of this unit's base Attack. Up to 8 can exist on the battlefield at the same time (cannot be summoned if there are no available follower slots). After any enemy takes an action, all Split Black Sperm on the battlefield have a 70% chance to perform a Follow-Up against all enemies. Each Split Black Sperm deals 480% Attack as [Specialized Direct DMG].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Upon entering battle, permanently reduces DMG taken by 50%. After each time this unit is attacked, 4 Split Black Sperm are created to assist in battle. Each Split Black Sperm inherits 120% of this unit's base Attack. Up to 8 can exist on the battlefield at the same time (cannot be summoned if there are no available follower slots). After any enemy takes an action, all Split Black Sperm on the battlefield have a 100% chance to perform a Follow-Up against all enemies. Each Split Black Sperm deals 620% Attack as [Specialized Direct DMG]. When an allied hero in the same row triggers [Rebattle], Split Black Sperm immediately multiply until the maximum limit is reached, then perform a [Charged Follow-Up] with 120% skill power.
